risk_if_not_implemented: Without Hardware Integrity Verification, applications may be built and deployed with exploitable design and coding weaknesses that adversaries can leverage. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Counterfeit / Non-Conforming Component Impact (R-SC-7), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Physical Crime (MT-5), Counterfeit / Non-Conforming Products (MT-20).

compensating_control_1.name: Configuration Management Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of configuration management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Hardware Integrity Verification (TDA-20.4) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Developer Configuration Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to require system developers and integrators to perform configuration management during system design, development, implementation and operation.
compensating_control_2.justification: Developer Configuration Management (TDA-20) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Hardware Integrity Verification (TDA-20.4) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
